# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 20 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Market

- **238 HDB flats sold above $1 million in October 2026** - Million-dollar HDB transactions reached 238 in October 2026, up sharply from 86 in the same month a year ago, with Toa Payoh leading at 39 deals and Queenstown recording 31. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/238-hdb-flats-sold-s1m-october/)

## Private Residential Market

- **98% of Marina One Residences resellers recorded a loss, with a median loss of $339,000** - In the 12 months to 18 October 2026, 45 of 46 resales at Marina One Residences transacted below the owner's purchase price, compared with just 5.2% of condo resales islandwide recording losses over the same period. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/marina-one-residences-45-46-resales/)

- **CapitaLand-led consortium bids $1.824 billion for Jurong East white site** - The bid is for the Town Hall Link site in Jurong East, which is planned to deliver 1,200 new homes near the MRT as part of the broader Jurong Lake District development. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/1-8-billion-bid-turn-jurong/)

- **CCR condo sellers are seeing vastly different outcomes — from million-dollar gains to million-dollar losses** - The Core Central Region market is splitting across compact own-stay homes, high-quantum legacy units, and trophy assets, producing widely divergent profit and loss results for sellers. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/prime-district-condo-owners-make-millions/)

## Construction & Commercial

- **JLL expects Singapore construction costs to rise 2.5%–3.5% in 2026** - Rising costs are expected to push some developers toward asset enhancement and adaptive reuse of existing buildings rather than new construction. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/rising-construction-costs-set-force-developers/)

- **Shophouse transactions on track for a nine-year low of 75 deals in 2026** - Total shophouse transaction value is down 18% to $675 million, with a price standoff between buyers and sellers cited as a key factor, even as rents hold at $6.50 psf per month. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/shophouse-sales-hit-9-year-low/)
